_readme: Reasoned reconstruction, same convention as fika-sync/engine_spec.json. This workflow chains 5 systems: slack, team-health-analyzer, google_calendar, calcom, sheets. Unlike the original diagnosis ('5 chained integrations, none tested individually'), each provider already has its own module with individual unit tests (see modules/*/README.md) -- what's missing is validating each one against a real account (VALIDATION.md) and, only after that, testing the full chain end to end.
